data.name: Arnay
data.gender_notes: Arnay is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Arnay is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Arni', meaning 'elephant'. This name is associated with Ganesha, the elephant-headed Hindu god, who is considered the Lord of Animals and the Remover of Obstacles. It is a powerful and spiritual name with deep roots in Hindu mythology. The name Arnay carries the meaning “Lord of Animals” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Arnay usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of animals and live with faith, good character and purpose.
